### 1. What the user expresses, and simulator behaviour

- Target object: one reefer container AHLU3184257, booking AHLU26VLC318457, export out of Valencia (script: "one reefer container, AHLU3184257, that went out of Valencia on booking AHLU26VLC318457").
- Two requests: (a) "a goodwill gesture on the demurrage, meaning those port days, and on nothing else"; (b) "pay off whatever your company owes on this container today, so that the file is closed".
- Authorisation / boundary: goodwill on demurrage only ("If the agent asks whether you want goodwill on any other charge, you say no"); agent may do record work first ("If the agent says that something has to be done on the record first, you let the agent go ahead"); payment is the customer's own card act, only when handed the payment and told the amount now owed, reference = booking number verbatim.
- The simulator conveys needs, supplies identity (phone +34963384152, customer code AHL-ES-318604, email as third), responds conditionally, and executes the user tool only when handed over. It gives no figures ("You do not know any of the amounts, rates or day counts"). Movement dates from the customer are vague and deferred to the line's records ("the line's own records are what count"), matching the KB rule "A customer's own account of when a container moved never takes the place of a recorded date." (clock_start_and_stop_4d104505).

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse, with eligibility grounds

Act now, everything on the spot.
- Identity: `verify_customer_identity` with phone + customer code returns "Identity confirmed ... (2 detail(s) matched in this attempt)".
- Record state: find_dnd_free_time → `status 'clock_stopped'`, `clock_stopped_date '2026-09-04'`, `balance_due_usd 245.0`; ledger for the record shows only `dnd_extension_fee_charged` 245.00 (target_variant AHL Combined Free Time 14). No invoice line exists.
- Invoicing is permitted and in time: "Invoice lines can be booked only on a record that shows clock stopped or invoiced" and deadline "counted in calendar days from the day the charges stopped accruing" (invoice_issue_minimum_and_due_date_db4cb926); deadline 30 days for AHL Combined Free Time 14 (invoicing_deadline_minimum_terms_4252a40a) → 2026-10-04; today 2026-09-14 is in time.
- Goodwill eligibility (goodwill_waivers_ccafefff conditions; figures goodwill_allowances_905510d3 for AHL Combined Free Time 14: 15 %, cap 500.00, quota 2, window 45 days):
  - quota: customer ledger shows commercial_goodwill waivers dated 2026-04-20 and 2025-03-06; trailing 365 days ending 2026-09-14 covers 2025-09-15..2026-09-14 → 1 waiver < 2 → available;
  - window: counted from the demurrage line's invoice date, which is the booking day (today) → inside;
  - one per line: no waiver on the (new) line; pending disputes: `find_dnd_disputes` → "No invoice disputes found";
  - product percentage not 0;
  - operational cause excluded: the customer asks for "a goodwill gesture", does not allege a line-caused delay or closure; `find_booking_charges` for the booking → "No booking charge entries found" (no roll notice), gate-in 2026-08-29 precedes cargo cut-off 2026-09-02T12:00, loading 2026-09-04 before ETD 2026-09-05. So the commercial-goodwill branch, not the operations-department branch ("A waiver on account of a delay caused by the line or a terminal closure is granted by the operations department alone").
- Payment eligibility: "A payment can be booked only on a record that shows invoiced" (payments_and_settlement_405a16c8) → only after the lines are booked; reference uniqueness is per record and the record carries no payment yet.

### 4. Scored parameters in words, inputs, intermediates, final values

Governing product: "Whatever product the record carries at the moment its last clock stops governs every clock" (clock_start_and_stop_4d104505) → AHL Combined Free Time 14: combined clock, offset 1 (clock_model_and_counting_start_a7d45fa3), merged export free days 14 (free_day_allowances_bba7fa59), slab lengths 5/5/10 (charge_slab_lengths_f1c05389).

Rate class: 40RH → reefer class (equipment_classes_and_contract_tier_f59898a4); booking cargo type reefer → stays reefer for both detention (detention_rate_class_by_cargo_be5a2b3d) and demurrage (demurrage_rate_class_by_cargo_edc72a24). No dangerous-goods uplift (cargo type reefer; demurrage_dangerous_goods_rates_ae2aec56 "any other | none").

Merged export clock: empty pickup 2026-08-10 → loading 2026-09-04, days used 25 ("Its n-th day is the date reached by adding n calendar days to the start date"); chargeable positions 15..25 (2026-08-25 .. 2026-09-04), 11 days. Full gate-in 2026-08-29 = position 19.

- Detention line (detention_clock_and_chargeable_days_1f47e4f2: export detention = positions above free days and not above the gate-in position): positions 15..19 → chargeable_days 5, period 2026-08-25 .. 2026-08-29 (line closes on the gate-in date). Slab count for merged export detention starts at 1 (detention_slab_position_3bb8a893) → 5 days in slab 1. Reefer detention slab 1 under AHL Combined Free Time 14 = 120.00 (detention_rates_reefer_ae211589). Amount = 5 × 120.00 = 600.00, rounded once.
- Demurrage line (demurrage_clock_and_chargeable_days_9c7ac099: export demurrage = positions above both free days and gate-in position): positions 20..25 → chargeable_days 6, period 2026-08-30 .. 2026-09-04. Slab count continues after the 5 chargeable days on the booked detention line (demurrage_slab_position_f32738fa) → demurrage positions 6..11 → 5 days slab 2, 1 day slab 3. Reefer demurrage under AHL Combined Free Time 14: slab 2 225.00, slab 3 320.00 (demurrage_rates_reefer_0de3170c). Amount = 5 × 225.00 + 1 × 320.00 = 1445.00, no uplift.
- Minimum invoice 25.00 (invoicing_deadline_minimum_terms_4252a40a): 2045.00 ≥ 25.00 → invoice raised.
- Goodwill on the demurrage line (goodwill_figure_sizing_43ae55c5): open amount on the line = 1445.00 (nothing booked against it; demurrage_line_open_amount_e091b648); recomputed amount under the same method = 1445.00 (goodwill_recomputation_ceiling_dc410a71); gross base = min = 1445.00; DG share none (goodwill_cargo_type_effects_1c4df4f7, cargo reefer) → base 1445.00; 15 % = 216.75; cap 500.00 not binding; round down to cent → 216.75. Booked against the demurrage line's invoice reference returned by the booking reply.
- Balance progression: 245.00 → +600.00 = 845.00 → +1445.00 = 2290.00 → −216.75 = 2073.25.
- Card payment (customer, user tool): amount 2073.25 (the balance then owed; "A payment may not be larger than the record's balance due"), payment_reference `AHLU26VLC318457` verbatim (card_payment_tool_e57149be), dnd_id given by the desk.
- Settlement: `settle_dnd_record_d9ada3ba` on the record once balance is 0.00 (record_settlement_tool_f66fe82a; payments_and_settlement_405a16c8 "When payments, waivers and credits bring the balance to 0.00, the record is closed as settled"; the card tool "does not change the record's status").

### 6. Problem tree derived from visible materials alone

Root problems stated by the customer: R1 goodwill on the demurrage; R2 pay everything owed and close the file.

- P1 — the demurrage has no invoice line (blocks R1). Facts: record status `clock_stopped`, ledger holds only the extension fee. Principle on the blocked side: goodwill "is a reduction of the demurrage invoice line that the record's account shows. Its size is measured from that line's invoiced amount, and it is booked against that line's invoice reference" (demurrage_line_open_amount_e091b648); the goodwill tool's `reference_event_id` is "the invoice reference of the line being reduced" (goodwill_waiver_on_demurrage_9dc5312e); the request window counts "from the date the invoice being waived was issued" (goodwill_waivers_ccafefff). Depended-on rule: final demurrage line via `book_demurrage_invoice_a2ad21e7` on a record that "shows clock stopped or invoiced". Mark: **read off** — the same doc states the consequence outright: "Demurrage that has not been raised on the record as an invoice line therefore gives goodwill neither an amount to be measured from nor a line to be booked against."; and merged_clock_record_closeout_0b983d0c: "Goodwill therefore rests on the demurrage line standing on the record." (It would also be derivable from the first two sentences + tool contract alone.)
- P2 — the demurrage figure on a merged export record needs the detention line on the record (blocks P1). Facts: combined product, direction export, both detention and demurrage chargeable days. Principle: "Their count is therefore taken from the record itself and carries on from the chargeable days entered on the detention line booked on the record ... A record whose final invoice has no detention line at all contributes no detention days, and its first demurrage day is then position 1." (demurrage_slab_position_f32738fa); same continuation in goodwill_recomputation_ceiling_dc410a71 ("carries on after the chargeable days entered on the detention line booked on the record"). Depended-on rule: `book_detention_invoice_dba94f21`. Mark: **derived** from demurrage_slab_position + the record's direction/clock model; but also **read off** in merged_clock_record_closeout_0b983d0c: "so the demurrage figure rests on the detention line standing on the record."
- P3 — a payment needs an invoiced record (blocks R2). Fact: status `clock_stopped`. Principle: "A payment can be booked only on a record that shows invoiced." and the Q&A "Can a payment be taken on a record whose clock has stopped but which has not yet been invoiced? No" (payments_and_settlement_405a16c8). Mark: **derived** (base rule + status fact); the Q&A phrases the task's own world state (clock stopped, not invoiced) — noted for the implicitness scan.
- P4 — the payment amount must be the balance after the goodwill (orders goodwill before payment). Principles: "A payment may not be larger than the record's balance due" and settlement at 0.00 (payments_and_settlement_405a16c8); goodwill lowers the balance (goodwill tool effect). Combining: a payment of the pre-goodwill balance followed by goodwill would leave a negative balance / a payment larger than the balance, which the rules exclude; paying and leaving goodwill undone would ignore R1. Mark: **derived**; also **read off** in merged_clock_record_closeout_0b983d0c: "The sum that does both is the balance that remains once every reduction the record is to receive — here, the goodwill — is on it, so the payment rests on the goodwill standing on the record." and its Q&A "Why is the card payment for the balance then owed rather than for the invoiced total?".
- P5 — closure is a separate desk act after the balance reaches 0.00. Principles: card tool "does not change the record's status"; settle tool "marks the free-time record settled ... books nothing"; settlement "when payments, waivers and credits bring the balance to 0.00". Mark: **derived**; also **read off** in merged_clock_record_closeout_0b983d0c: "Settlement therefore rests on the balance already standing at nothing."

Dependency direction: P2 → P1 → R1(goodwill) → P4(payment amount) → R2 payment → P5 settle; P3 is satisfied by P2/P1 bookings.
Handling order: detention line → demurrage line → goodwill waiver → customer card payment (user tool) → settle.

Additional observation for the implicitness scan: merged_clock_record_closeout_0b983d0c describes this exact combination ("a record on a combined clock whose last clock has stopped, which has not yet been invoiced, and whose merged clock has chargeable days both while the container was inside the terminal and while it was outside; within one contact, the billed party seeks commercial goodwill on the demurrage and wants the record paid off at once by card") and its terminal state ("the record carries its final detention line and its final demurrage line, a single commercial goodwill waiver against the demurrage line, a single card payment equal to the balance that was then owed, and it stands settled with nothing owing"), and states every dependency edge of the tree as "rests on". A reader can take the whole tree from this single document.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Support: every value above is obtained from a quoted KB sentence plus a tool return; the dry run reproduces the terminal state with the tool contracts as documented.
- Closest alternatives excluded:
  - demurrage slab count starting at position 1 (975.00 = 5 × 150.00 + 1 × 225.00): excluded by demurrage_slab_position_f32738fa (merged export continues after the detention line's days; position 1 only when the final invoice has no detention line — this one has a 5-day detention line).
  - dry-class pricing of the 40RH: excluded — cargo type is reefer ("reefer | reefer | reefer").
  - separate-clock treatment / 14 days per clock: excluded — clock_model table "AHL Combined Free Time 14 | combined".
  - pricing under AHL Tariff Free Time (the product at opening): excluded by "Whatever product the record carries at the moment its last clock stops governs every clock".
  - goodwill 15 % of the total invoice or of the balance (2290.00 / 2045.00): excluded — goodwill on demurrage is measured from the demurrage line and the customer refuses goodwill on anything else.
  - goodwill under the retired general wording (open amount × 15 %, same 216.75 here): the retired wording is marked "no longer in force for a demurrage invoice line" (goodwill_waivers_ccafefff); the current basis gives the same figure in this world because open = recomputed and no DG share.
  - quota exhausted: excluded — the 2025-03-06 waiver falls outside the 365-day period ending 2026-09-14.
  - operations waiver instead of commercial goodwill: excluded — no delay caused by the line / closure alleged, no roll notice.
  - paying 2290.00 then waiving: excluded — "A payment may not be larger than the record's balance due", and the overpaid part "is returned by finance and is not booked".
  - stopping after the payment without settle: excluded — the card tool "does not change the record's status".
- Wrong answer "do only what the customer asked" (grant goodwill + take payment on the current record): excluded because goodwill has no line to be measured from or booked against (demurrage_line_open_amount_e091b648) and a payment cannot be booked on a record not showing invoiced (payments_and_settlement_405a16c8); both principles plus the record status `clock_stopped` leave that path impossible. Doing only the demurrage line (without detention) is excluded because the demurrage figure on a merged export record continues from the detention line's days and the final invoice consists of both lines (chargeable_days_and_day_rates_23cbb4f8 clause 7).
